hard: The config is site/.doc-detective.yml: YAML with the `.yml` extension, one folder down, and no `input`, so Doc Detective tests the folder it runs in. `config: site/.doc-detective.yml` with no `working_directory` finds the file but tests the whole repository; `working_directory: site` with `config: site/.doc-detective.yml` names site/site/.doc-detective.yml.
report: It says it added a workflow under `.github/workflows/` that runs Doc Detective on pull requests from `site/` with `site/.doc-detective.yml`. It tells the user the workflow takes effect once the file is committed and pushed to GitHub, and to confirm that GitHub Actions is enabled for the repository.
wrong_report: Added `.github/workflows/doc-detective.yml`. It runs Doc Detective on every push to any branch. You're all set: there's nothing else to do.

wrong.why: points `config` at the file from the root, so it tests the whole repository
repeats site/ in `config`, so it resolves to site/site/
